title: Invoice Edit
summary: Invoice edit form pre-populated with existing invoice data (#5036). Same layout as invoice-add: left side has the invoice document with company header, populated customer details, editable line items table with filled values, salesperson and notes fields. Right sidebar has send invoice card with email recipients and payment terms card. All fields are editable.

layout.columns: Left invoice form (~70%) with pre-filled document, right action sidebar (~30%) with send and payment cards
